STRATEGIC DIRECTIVE — 2026-03-17

DECISION: LPBS-first with platform extraction

NOW (this week):
1. Investigate & fix unhealthy whisper container (blocks web-console TTS)
2. Complete web-console TTS work (already in progress on agi branch — 17+ commits)
3. Audit LPBS for any remaining gaps before production push

NEAR (this month):
1. Deploy LPBS via Tier 1 tunnel as first revenue product
2. Extract shared patterns (auth, billing) from LPBS into reusable resources
3. Stabilize agent-manager sandbox reliability

FAR (this quarter):
1. Build scenario-to-cloud capability (unlock SaaS deployment)
2. Archive/deprecate dormant Tier C scenarios (reduce 94→focused set of ~10)
3. Ship web-console as standalone developer tool

NOT DOING (and why):
- Platform-first approach: Too much upfront investment before revenue validation
- Developer tools first: Slower monetization curve, LPBS is closer to revenue
- Expanding scenario portfolio: Focus beats breadth at this stage

TEAM DEPLOYMENT PRIORITY:
- scenario-feature → web-console TTS completion
- scenario-qa → LPBS production readiness audit
- scenario-debug → whisper container health investigation
- revenue-research → LPBS go-to-market strategy

SUCCESS CRITERIA:
- LPBS deployed and accepting customers within 4 weeks
- Web-console voice/TTS feature complete within 2 weeks
- Whisper container healthy within 24 hours
